messages:
Taylor: RC ready: 3.2.1-rc1 built, docker images pushed, changelog drafted. Target change window 22:00-00:00 UTC tonight.
Ravi: QA quick smoke done on staging. Noted a minor tokenization edge case in chat-ttf that was addressed in rc1. Release notes updated with the fix.
Kim: I updated k8s rollout strategy to use maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=0 for smoother pod transitions. No DB migrations.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduled oncall: night-shift (Irene) + backup oncall (Ravi). Post-deploy ping will be sent to #incidents.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks running: image scans, e2e smoke, config lint. Preflight PASS. Promote syntax: `/promote rc=3.2.1-rc1 env=prod window=22:00-00:00 strategy=staged`
Irene: Confirming I can be on the 22:00-23:30 watch. If we need a rollback, I'll coordinate the DNS rollbacks and pod pinning.
Taylor: Rollback plan: pin traffic to 3.1.9, scale down new pods, toggle feature-flag `rc_3_2_1` off, and revert config map if needed. Deadman threshold: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR tail-latency p95 > 1s.
Ravi: Observability hooks: dashboards wired, synthetic probes set to 30s, PagerDuty rule `PROD_DEPLOY_CRIT` attached.
Kim: Can we enable a short KV cache warm-up window to avoid cold-kv spikes? I can add a pre-warm job 10m before promote.
Taylor: Good call, add pre-warm. Include a note in release notes: "KV warm-up runs prior to full rollout."
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pre-warm job scheduled at 21:50 UTC.
Taylor: Final thumbs?
Ravi: +1 (QA)
Irene: +1 (Ops)
Kim: +1 (Infra)
Taylor: Go for promote at 22:00.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: executing `/promote rc=3.2.1-rc1 -> prod` with staged strategy. Wave A: 5% at 22:00, Wave B: 25% at 22:10, Wave C: 70% at 22:25.
Ravi: Wave A: smoke OK, no obvious regressions.
Kim: k8s rollout healthy, pods passing readiness.
ops-bot: ops-bot: alert suppression active for deploy window (non-critical).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave B started -> 25%.
Irene: Watching APM: traces okay, small GC bump but within expected after spinup.
Taylor: Pause on Wave C until probe metrics stable for 6m.
Ravi: 6m steady, synthetic latency within baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Wave C ramp -> 100% started.
Kim: Full rollout in progress, configmap applied successfully.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promote complete. Service now at 3.2.1. Release notes: https://internal/release/3.2.1-rc1.
Taylor: Nice work everyone :tada: I'll keep an eye for 30m then close the RFC.
Irene: If anything pops, I'll open an incident and tag the rollout owners.
Ravi: leaving a quick postmortem checklist in #eng-releases later.
